passages.provision_quote: Notwithstanding any other provision of law, the President may not declare a moratorium on the use of hydraulic fracturing unless such moratorium is authorized by an Act of Congress.
passages.note: Operative section bars a presidential moratorium on one technique absent an Act of Congress; it allocates who decides and requires no new drilling or permits.
Yea on an LNG export/import authorization bill; export is not production under the annex, so adjacent.
passages.actor_quote: Houchin Houchin Republican Indiana IN Yea

passages.provision_quote: In determining whether to approve or deny an application under this paragraph, the Commission shall deem the exportation or importation of natural gas to be consistent with the public interest.
passages.note: Co-sponsored; the operative text governs export/import facility approval, not drilling, leasing or production levels.
Her quoted words concern year-round E-15 biofuel sales, not fossil fuel production; the 'domestic energy production' line is third-person characterization.

rows.reasoning: H.R. 1121 only bars the President from declaring a fracking moratorium without an Act of Congress, which allocates who decides rather than requiring 'new drilling and permits'; H.R. 7176 concerns natural gas export/import approval, which the annex treats as not production; the E-15 statement is about biofuels. No passage speaks to the trajectory of fossil fuel production, so no rung (e.g. 'Expand fossil fuel production with new drilling and permits') is evidenced.
